sources.title: Chicago Building Permits Digital Collection 1872–1954
sources.description: UIC collection: first locate historical address in street index, record permit number/date/book/page, select matching South-side ledger date span, then verify permit number and address. Pre-1912 permits span rows and sometimes two pages; fields can include owner, stories, frontage, depth, lot/block/subdivision and building type. Amount received can be permit fee, not construction cost.
sources.applicability_1904: Handwritten collection requires page-level transcription. No Prairie-specific permit has been retrieved in this pass. Fire reports 1933–1968 and construction data 1917–1925 are later context, not 1904 evidence.
sources.rights: Rights not evaluated at item level.
sources.retrieval_status: UIC guide read via direct HTTP; digital collection returned 403. No individual permit retrieved.

sources.title: American Contractor building permit column index, 1898–1912
sources.description: Chicago History Museum index linked by CPL: route to permit notices, owner, architect and construction descriptions.
sources.applicability_1904: Index only until actual article/permit inspected. Search all Prairie addresses, aliases and cross-street addresses.
sources.rights: Finding aid; period newspaper/article rights at item level.
sources.retrieval_status: CPL link verified; direct request timed out

sources.title: Chicago 1909 street number changes guide
sources.description: Primary crosswalk for the large citywide 1909 address change; linked by CPL house-history guide.
sources.applicability_1904: Do not automatically renumber Prairie Avenue: verify address and parcel individually. Many core Prairie numbers appear stable between 1904 and 1910 Blue Books.
sources.rights: Original 1909 publication public domain; CHM scan terms not evaluated.
sources.retrieval_status: CPL link verified; web request timed out and direct download returned HTTP 502. Not downloaded.
